article.title: NATO’s Rutte Downplays ‘Tit for Tat’ Response to Russia
article.summary: NATO chief Mark Rutte said Tuesday that the alliance will not always respond “tit-for-tat” to Russian hybrid attacks despite having “the response options we need.” The statement came amid heightened Russian activity in and around Europe, including frequent drone incursions and border-crossing incidents, with Rutte’s recent remark that Article 5 should remain “deliberately ambiguous,” raising questions about how, and if, NATO will respond if things come to a head.
